hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*\.env"'; then echo 'Blocked: .env contains real secrets. Edit .env.example instead.' >&2; exit 2; fi
file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))") && case "$file" in *.go) go vet ./... 2>&1;; esac
